hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A peak occurs at index i where nums[i] is strictly greater than both its left and right neighbors.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Store peak status across indices in a binary indexed or segment tree structure.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Query range sums of internal peak positions and update neighbor states on point mutations.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Fenwick tree maintains peak indicators under point mutations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning every query interval takes linear time per query, yielding O(n * q) total.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fenwick array requires O(n) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies localized neighbor updates and uses Fenwick tree for range sum queries.
